BiblicalUsage: Choliy is sickness, the malady of the body, and Scripture uses it for both judgment and the suffering servant. Ahaziah falls through a lattice and sends to ask whether he will recover of his disease, the Lord promises to take away all sickness from His people, and Isaiah says the servant was a man of sorrows and acquainted with grief.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe sickness in the Bible is never only a body breaking down, because it always asks where we turn for help. I hold that the servant who bore our griefs is the answer to every disease in this word.
